body:
Date: 2026-09-30
Date: 2026-09-30
[self-imposed, su-f7ad1084, AUTO] Verdict recorded under the D-001 bar ([owner 2026-09-30 directive #1049] asked for Jev better than shipped). Variants built: v2-content (P-003), substance (P-005); pair (P-004) and score (P-006) were dropped before measuring (D-003). All numbers are arm B (production floor 0.58 + Jev), v1 at t=0.3, jev-1.13.0, instructions encoding, same-run v1 baselines.

Runs: admission on gold-set.v2 (210 queries, 90 hard negatives, P-002), fresh, LLM-judged negatives 656/656 graded with 0 judged relevant: v1 .papercusp/bench-reports/jev-admission-2026-09-30T16-53-16-130Z, v2-content T16-56-25-178Z, substance T16-59-10-000Z (one battery, background task 0muobppq8dvfxj1mntu). Robustness (150 questions x self-promoters, 3 repeats): v1 jev-robustness-2026-09-30T16-12-15-336Z, v2-content T16-17-20-328Z, substance T16-23-50-131Z. Paired stats: .papercusp/scratch/jev-paired-v2.mts.

v2-content, at the threshold its admission run selects (0.35):
(1a) self-promoter conditional admit 31.4% (216/687) -> 1.8% (12/683) at 0.35 [2.3% at 0.3; paired bootstrap diff at 0.3 29.1pt, 95% CI 26.5 to 32.1]; questions admitting a self-promoter 149/150 -> 11/150 (exact McNemar at 0.3 134/0, p=4.6e-41). PASS.
(1b) off-topic: hard-negative questions admitting anything 12/90 -> 7/90, McNemar onlyV1=5 onlyV2=0, one-sided p=0.0625. Better but not significant, so (1b) does not count as the improvement; it passes the (2) no-regression check.
(2) R@10 91.4% -> 91.4%, exact-id MRR 0.888 -> 0.897 on the 120 positives (no loss on any query). PASS.
(3) meets-measured-bar 3/3 repeats (gold v1) and again on gold v2; selected t 0.35/0.35/0.40 and 0.35 on gold v2. PASS.
(4) order flip 1.8% (noise floor 1.7%), p95 260 ms, timeouts 0.0%, cost 1.46e-4 vs 1.39e-4 USD/query (1.05x). PASS.

substance at its selected t: (1a) 31.4% -> 7.3% at 0.35 (9.3% at 0.3), (1b) 12/90 -> 9/90 at 0.35, R@10 unchanged, cost 1.92x, p95 255 ms. Passes, but its (1) improvement is smaller than v2-content's, so D-001's tie rule picks v2-content.

Outcome: production adopts v2-content at threshold 0.35 (P-008). The substance question lives on as the save-time block (P-010), where it is asked of a single memory.
